text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C and Stock B at gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; decide based on the stock’s prospects and my portfolio needs.","Avoid letting the pain of realizing a loss keep me invested by default; judge each holding objectively rather than against its purchase price.","My account fell over several months while I made no trades, but random past moves do not predict future returns; review holdings deliberately and trade only when there is a sound reason."]}
